page.overview:
Who is Akrep Xie?

Akrep Xie is a Deathwatch Chapter watch master who is the current watch commander of the Eye of Octos watch fortress in the Octarius Sector of the Segmentum Ultima. Prior to being seconded to the Deathwatch, Akrep Xie was a Veteran of the Jade Scorpions Chapter.

In the Era Indomitus Xie led the Eye of Octos' Deathwatch kill-teams to aid the Pankallis Sub-sector, after it was invaded by the forces of the Tyranid Hive Fleet Leviathan. Xie is currently fighting to cleanse the xenos from the planet called Death of Bianzeer, in the Bianzeer's Hollow System.

"Akrep" means "scorpion" in the related Semitic languages of Arabic, Hebrew and Akkadian.
